title: Publish decision-oriented research catalog views
instruction: Replace repetitive research-run-first catalog details with bilingual decision-oriented topic summaries that distinguish currently deployed, near-term, research, and unresolved technologies; add region and actor facets without treating origin as merit; publish comparable CPU/GPU software-stack and numerical-method capability matrices; and add MN-Core to ARCH-02. Use public sources only, preserve provenance and Coverage Gaps, and keep all new synthesis Consensus-incomplete until independent review.
